title: Worktree bbox_learn and bbox_render use asymmetric project scoping
wanted_capability: Learning a project-scoped entry from a managed worktree and immediately rendering project provider files should use the same resolved project scope, or otherwise make the mismatch explicit. The entry should not silently remain unrendered because bbox_learn stores it under the worktree path while bbox_render filters by the registered base repo path.
missing_primitive: shared worktree-to-base project scoping for bbox_learn/bbox_render, or a render diagnostic for excluded project entries
fallback_used: Identified the mismatch manually by grepping the worktree .bbox/knowledge entry and rendered provider files, then inspecting src/tools/render.rs and src/tools/knowledge.rs.
notes: Observed while adding a project-scoped rustfmt convention from /home/invidious/repos/transcript-search/.claude/worktrees/fleet-tui-tool-source-rendering. bbox_learn wrote .bbox/knowledge/daee9651.json in the worktree, but bbox_render rescoped the same worktree path to the registered base project for filtering and generated provider files without the new entry.
